overview: The Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee approved the contract with SMMA for feasibility study services and a payment invoice for Left Field. The committee also received detailed updates on educational programming, physical site investigations, and the structure of the upcoming MSBA space summary.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the previous meeting.

items.title: Approval of Invoices
items.summary: Approved a payment invoice for Left Field, followed by a brief budget update.

items.title: Approval of SMMA Contract
items.summary: Approved the contract with SMMA for feasibility study services, keeping optional services like geothermal testing available for future amendment.

items.title: Project Progress and Educational Envisioning Update
items.summary: The committee reviewed project schedule milestones and received updates on educational visioning, community feedback, and the completion of 49 department-level educational programming meetings.

items.title: Site Investigations Update
items.summary: Consultants detailed upcoming physical site investigations, including land and drone surveys, soil borings, noise level monitoring, bedrock mapping, and traffic observations.

items.title: Existing Building Studies and Scanning
items.summary: Representatives reported on a recent engineering walkthrough of the high school's systems and outlined plans to perform a 3D digital scan of the interior and exterior to produce accurate digital drawings.

items.title: Formation of Advisory Teams
items.summary: The committee introduced and distributed sign-ups for four advisory teams to gather specialized feedback on sustainability, safety, design, and educational planning.

items.title: MSBA Space Summary Overview
items.summary: The design team walked through the structure of the Massachusetts School Building Authority (MSBA) space summary template, which will document existing and proposed square footage across various school categories.

items.title: Project Next Steps and Alternatives Analysis
items.summary: The committee discussed upcoming milestones leading to the preliminary design program submission in February 2026, including how the committee will evaluate and narrow down building design alternatives.
